content:
Rork i need apk now RORK MAX — CLOSE THE CURRENT IVX CHAT P0
NO NEW FEATURES / NO NEW CERTIFICATION

Use the existing v1.10.10 / aa1a7da7 implementation.

Do not modify anything unless a remaining live test fails.

1. WAIT FOR RENDER HEALTH

Verify production repeatedly until:

https://api.ivxholding.com/health

returns HTTP 200 consistently.

Record:
- deploy ID
- deploy SHA
- runtime SHA
- health timestamps

If 502 persists:
find and fix the actual Render/backend startup failure first.

Do not continue QA against an unhealthy deployment.

2. VERIFY SHA PARITY

Prove:

GITHUB MAIN SHA
=
RENDER DEPLOY SHA
=
RUNTIME SHA

Expected current target:
aa1a7da7

If not equal:
STOP and repair deployment parity.

3. RUN LIVE TEST C

From real production IVX IA Chat ask a substantial business question.

PASS requires:

- no circular spinner
- no blocking loader
- one minimal pre-token indicator only
- first real answer text becomes visible while model is still generating
- progressive real streaming
- no post-answer thinking/responding state
- natural business-quality answer

Capture exact:
T0 send
T1 backend receive
T2 provider call
T3 first provider delta
T4 first SSE delta
T5 first client delta
T6 first visible text
T7 completion

Return actual milliseconds.

4. RUN LIVE TEST D — AUTHORIZATION PERSISTENCE

Start one real autonomous development task.

Owner approves ONCE.

Verify:

- real Task ID
- approval persisted
- retry/recovery does NOT ask for authorization again
- real queue
- real worker
- real coder
- real status events only
- no invented percentages
- final status comes from backend state

If task fails:
return exact stage/error and automatically recover when safe.

5. ANDROID REAL APP TEST

Use/build the current v1.10.10 APK.

Verify the installed application is actually the new version.

Return:

APP VERSION:
BUILD NUMBER:
APK HASH/PATH:
INSTALLED VERSION:

Then test:

- Spanish chat
- English chat
- real streaming
- no spinner
- no post-answer thinking
- autonomous task initiation

If no physical Android device is available:
ANDROID DEVICE QA = EXTERNAL-BLOCKED.

Do not claim PASS.

6. FINAL UI ACCEPTANCE

Normal chat must show:

SEND
→ minimal "IVX is responding..."
→ first real streamed text
→ indicator disappears
→ answer streams
→ completion
→ IDLE

Forbidden in normal chat:

- circular spinner
- ActivityIndicator
- watchdog
- Still working card
- Thinking after answer
- Working banner
- fake progress
- blank assistant bubble waiting for full response

7. SENIOR-DEVELOPER RESPONSE QA

Ask one technical question that does NOT require execution.

PASS requires a concise senior answer.

Ask one real engineering execution request.

PASS requires:

TASK ID
REAL STATUS
REAL EXECUTION EVIDENCE

No generic:
BUSINESS IMPACT
RECOMMENDED NEXT ACTION
long narrative report

unless explicitly requested.

8. FINAL RETURN

RENDER HEALTH:
PASS / FAIL

GITHUB SHA:

RENDER SHA:

RUNTIME SHA:

SHA PARITY:
PASS / FAIL

BUSINESS CHAT STREAMING:
PASS / FAIL

FIRST VISIBLE TOKEN:
<ms>

TOTAL RESPONSE TIME:
<ms>

CIRCULAR SPINNER:
REMOVED / PRESENT

POST-ANSWER THINKING:
REMOVED / PRESENT

FULL RESPONSE BUFFERING:
YES / NO

AUTHORIZATION PERSISTENCE:
PASS / FAIL

REAL AUTONOMOUS TASK:
PASS / FAIL

REAL TASK ID:
<id>

ANDROID APK VERSION:
<version>

ANDROID DEVICE QA:
PASS / FAIL / EXTERNAL-BLOCKED

REMAINING DEFECTS:
<NONE or exact list>

FINAL VERDICT:

IVX CHAT P0 — PRODUCTION VERIFIED

or

IVX CHAT P0 — NOT YET VERIFIED

STOP.

Do not create a new phase.
Do not add features.
Do not issue another certificate.
Close only the remaining live defects.
